evals.name: sdk-abort-signal-member
evals.source: G4 in the Voyager migration (aeharding/voyager@6a15757): its feeds pass `{ signal }` to the threadiverse SDK, and an AbortSignal in the endpoint's arguments becomes part of its cache key.
evals.expected_output: An `Endpoint` whose arguments are only `{ community, sort }` (or the SDK's key fields), which reads a declared `signal` member from `this` and passes it to `client.getPosts`; the component reads with `useSuspense(useCancelling(endpoint, args), args)`.
assertions: The endpoint's arguments hold no `AbortSignal`: no `signal` parameter, and no `key` override written to drop one.
The fetch function reads the signal from the endpoint (`this.signal`, a member declared in the options) and passes it to `client.getPosts`.
The component aborts the old sort's request through `useCancelling(endpoint, args)` (or `endpoint.extend({ signal })`), with the same args passed to `useSuspense()`.
The component reads with `useSuspense()` and has no `useEffect` or `useState` for the posts.
